_doc: Measured values for the Delta Face vertical slice (P93, 2026-11-19). Each entry: value, unit, confidence (high/medium/low), method, sources, and config_key (the key it should replace; 'p87:' = branch claude/p87-delta-face-levels delta_face_levels.json). Nothing reads this file yet: a builder applies a value by editing the config key and citing the entry id. Methods and caveats: docs/research/delta-face-measurements.md. Satellite widths are Google Maps 21z pixel profiles (10.9 px/m in the saved frame, about +-0.5 m); Street View widths are perspective estimates (+-1.5 m); OSM values are from ways and tags read through the Overpass API on 2026-11-19.
_doc_round2: Round 2 (P98, 2026-11-19): entries prefixed r2. carry 'round': 2. A round-1 entry with 'superseded_by' is replaced by the named entry. Methods: docs/research/delta-face-measurements.md, 'Round 2'.
_doc_round5: Round 5 (P122, 2026-11-20): entries prefixed r5. measure the Centre Road cross-section from the agent aerial (scale bar). Method: Agent phone aerial (828x1792) of the Delta Face seafront road, scale bar 10 m = 130 px (bar rule x 552-681 at y 1415-1417, 129-131 px; 13.0 px/m, +-1%). Image cropped y 300-1400 and rotated 23.5 deg so the road axis is vertical (axis from the two median islands, dx/dy 0.43). Perpendicular widths from median-of-120-rows luminance profiles at stations A (rot y 200-320), B (600-720, between the medians) and C (850-970). Mild oblique foreshortening is unknown (aerial may be tilted), so add +-5%.

centre_road.nb_carriageway_m.method: Satellite pixel profile across Delta Face Centre Road at 6.9248, 79.8449 (21z, bearing -22 deg): NB solid edge line to centre double line, with one dashed lane line between them.
centre_road.nb_carriageway_m.config_key: delta_face.json road_overrides / dual_carriageways 'Delta Face Centre Road' (NB half); was 2 x 3.5 = 7.0
centre_road.nb_carriageway_m.note: 2 lanes of about 3.3 m. The angled-bay strip is outside the edge line.

centre_road.sb_carriageway_m.method: Same profile: centre double line to the land-side kerb, read where the kerb is visible between trees.
centre_road.sb_carriageway_m.config_key: delta_face.json dual_carriageways 'Delta Face Centre Road' (SB half)
centre_road.sb_carriageway_m.note: Wider than NB: 2 lanes plus about 2.5 m kerbside space (bus stop or stopping lane). Tree canopy overhangs the kerb, so read it again in Street View.

centre_road.median_m.method: Satellite: a painted centre double line, no raised median, at 6.9248 N. OSM draws the two carriageways 7.8-9.4 m apart (centreline to centreline), which agrees with a painted divide.
centre_road.median_m.config_key: delta_face.json dual_carriageways 'Delta Face Centre Road' median_m 0 + centre_line (keep)

centre_road.lanes_each_way.method: OSM lanes=2 on both carriageways; a dashed lane line visible in each half on the satellite image; Street View (Jun 2020) shows lane lines.
centre_road.lanes_each_way.config_key: delta_face.json lanes on Delta Face Centre Road (keep)

centre_road.angled_parking_strip_m.method: Satellite profile: the bay strip west of the NB edge line is about 7 m deep; Street View at 6.92530 and 6.927 shows diagonal bays along the whole Green.
centre_road.angled_parking_strip_m.note: Within the error of the config's 7.5 m; keep 7.5 or set 7.0. The bays run about 1.0 km of the Green, not only the south end.

centre_road.sea_side_paver_strip_m.method: Satellite profile: red paver and planter strip between the bay strip and the Green, about 15-17 m; Street View shows red pavers, planters and a pay station, with the Green about level with it.
centre_road.sea_side_paver_strip_m.note: Range 15-17 m includes the planter line. Wider than the config's 8.5 m; check the build does not eat the Green.

green.road_side_steps_spacing_m.method: OSM: eight highway=steps incline=down flights from sea-side sidewalk 1489623836 into the Green, at chainage 98, 176, 251, 330, 406, 484, 562 and 642 m from the south end of Centre Road (gaps 75-80 m).
green.road_side_steps_spacing_m.note: The flights are 5.6-8.7 m long on plan: short flights, not the 24 m terrace_steps_run_m.

green.road_side_drop_m.method: Inferred: OSM maps 'down' steps from the roadside pavement into the Green, but Street View at mid-Green and at 6.927 shows the Green about level with the paver strip. Range 0-0.45 m.

north_steps.exists_as_flight.method: No OSM steps way along the p87 north-steps line (6.926275, 79.844341 to 6.927762, 79.843561); satellite at 20z shows no long shadowed flight there; Street View at 6.927 shows the Green about level with the paver strip.
north_steps.exists_as_flight.config_key: p87: step_runs[north_end_steps_one_delta_face] (3 steps x 0.4 m tread, 205 m)
north_steps.exists_as_flight.note: A 205 m continuous flight is not in the data. Keep it as an ESTIMATE until a local confirms; the measured pattern is short flights every 78 m.
north_steps.exists_as_flight.agent_decision: 2026-11-19: drop the 205 m north-end flight on the Green (see r2.north_steps.form).

promenade.seawall_to_green_m.method: Satellite pixel profile at the pier (6.9244, 79.8442, 21z): seawall top edge to the Green edge 14-17 m (29 m at the flag-post plaza).
promenade.seawall_to_green_m.note: This is the whole sea-side band: the Drive asphalt plus the kiosk/paver strip. The config's 10 m is short.

promenade.drive_asphalt_m.method: Satellite profile at the pier: asphalt strip next to the seawall 6-7 m wide. OSM Delta Face Drive (way 18599197, highway=pedestrian, asphalt, lit, maxspeed 40) runs 2.3-3.9 m (median 2.7 m) from the barrier=wall line 1489623826, which agrees with a strip of about 5.5-7 m.
promenade.drive_asphalt_m.note: Delta Face Drive is pedestrian with service traffic (maxspeed 40).

seawall.height_above_beach_m.method: Carried from DELTA_FACE_MEASURED.md (photos, 2.3-3.0 m). The shadow band at the pier is a steady 2.0-2.2 m wide, but the sun angle of the image is unknown, so it does not give a height.
seawall.height_above_beach_m.note: No new number; the sea side by the pier is armour rock, not sand.

seawall.beach_steps_chainage_m.method: OSM steps ways crossing the barrier=wall line 1489623826, chainage from its south end; runs 2-7 m on plan.
seawall.beach_steps_chainage_m.note: Four beach stairs, irregular, not every 110 m.

seawall.foreshore_m.method: OSM natural=coastline is 7-27 m beyond the wall line.
seawall.foreshore_m.note: Varies along the wall; 6 m is the low end.

new_baladaksha.carriageway_m.method: Design figure from the contractor's completion notice: four lanes of 3.3 m. Street View (Feb 2022) perspective estimate at 6.92696, 79.84574 gives about 10.5 m +-1.5 m kerb to kerb.
new_baladaksha.carriageway_m.config_key: drive_circle.json road_overrides 'New Baladaksha Mawatha' width 7.0, lanes 2
new_baladaksha.carriageway_m.note: Clearly wider than 7.0 m. Use 13.2 m / 4 lanes unless a local says lanes are coned off; the Street View estimate leans narrower (10.5 m).
new_baladaksha.carriageway_m.agent_decision: 2026-11-19: slice era 2026; New Baladaksha Mawatha is a real 4-lane road, build it at about 13.2 m.

new_baladaksha.footpaths_m.method: Design figures from the same notice (right and left of chainage direction, Delta Road 0+000 to Justice Akbar 1+186). Street View: east side red paver footway with a yellow tactile strip about 1.5-2 m; west side a wide concrete pavement along the ITC podium.
new_baladaksha.footpaths_m.config_key: rules pavement default for primary (2.5 m)

new_baladaksha.is_road.method: Street View (Google car, Feb 2022): asphalt, white edge lines, a solid lane line, arrows and 'Baladaksha' road text, kerbs. Built by Access Engineering for the CMC (2018) as a four-lane road.
new_baladaksha.is_road.config_key: delta_face.json road_overrides 'New Baladaksha Mawatha' highway pedestrian (superseded by drive_circle.json)
new_baladaksha.is_road.note: OSM still tags part of it as a walk path. Whether it is open to traffic every day is a local question (question 4).
new_baladaksha.is_road.agent_decision: 2026-11-19: a road (drivable in the slice), not a walk path.

new_baladaksha.delta_road_connector_m.method: Design figure: a 7 m two-lane connector to Delta Road.
new_baladaksha.delta_road_connector_m.config_key: drive_circle.json joins join_north_shangrila width 7.0 (keep; it is the north link, check it is the same connector)

macan_markar.carriageway_m.method: Kept from ROAD_WIDTHS_MEASURED (Antigravity). Satellite blocked by tree canopy. Street View (Jun 2020) at 6.9216038, 79.8476981 shows a two-way road with white edge lines and a short centre line.
macan_markar.carriageway_m.note: Street View reads as 2 marked lanes plus parking edges, not 4 marked lanes; lanes 2 + parking is the safer read.

macan_markar.pavements_m.method: Street View perspective: west a shaded footway about 2.5-3 m behind a cream boundary wall about 2.4 m high with piers; east about 3 m pavement with palms in front of a 5-storey office with green-trimmed bands and ground-floor parking.

hotel.north_wing_frontage_m.method: OSM building 341982692 (Heritage/north wing) footprint 101 x 45 m, building:levels 4.

hotel.storeys.method: OSM building:levels 4 on wings 341982692, 341982691, 341982694; 2 on the south block 341982695 (80 x 38 m). Site 147 x 118 m.

hotel.facade_height_m.method: Not measured: no OSM height tag on the hotel; 4 colonial storeys suggest about 18-20 m to the parapet, an estimate only.

delta_road.opposite_block_storeys.method: OSM building:levels and height on the blocks across Delta Road from the hotel (77 x 55 m and 24 x 50 m).
delta_road.opposite_block_storeys.config_key: city kit storey rules for these footprints

levels.dem.method: Tried SRTM, ASTER and Mapzen through opentopodata: 0-16 m with buildings and canopy mixed in, useless for 0.5 m level steps.

r2.green.road_side_drop_m.method: Dotcom Systems Street View panorama (captured Mar 2020) at 6.92507, 79.84500, looking 255-292 deg: sand runs on from the paver strip with people standing at the strip's level, no wall face beside OSM step way at 6.92516, 79.84472. Agrees with round 1 (Jun 2020 panorama).
sources: OSM highway=steps incline=down ways off sidewalk 1489623836
Daily FT 2018-03-06 column (says about 1.5 m stepped wall: not seen at mid-Green)
r2.green.road_side_drop_m.config_key: p87 areas[north_steps_foot].dz -0.45 (within range); green roadside drop
r2.green.road_side_drop_m.note: Confirms round 1 green.road_side_drop_m (range 0-0.45) and raises its confidence. The 2018 FT figure is open: question 1.

r2.green.road_side_step_risers.method: Inferred: a drop of 0.45 m or less divided by a 0.15 m riser. Tread not measurable from the air or the panoramas.
r2.green.road_side_step_risers.config_key: delta_face.json dressing.terrace_steps_run_m 24 (too long for a 0.3-0.45 m drop)

r2.north_steps.form.method: Elevated photo of the One Delta Face front: a level paver strip with a low edge runs along the road, and one short, wide flight of about 3 risers (0.45-0.5 m) leads down to the Green opposite the entrance. Esri 2026 shows a square plaza at the north tip and no terrace or long flight.
sources: Esri World Imagery z19 (Vantor Legion LG05, 2026-02-26, 0.34 m, accuracy 8.47 m per the World Imagery identify service); tiles kept in the session scratch folder only
r2.north_steps.form.config_key: p87 step_runs[north_end_steps_one_delta_face] (3 x 0.4 m, 205 m) -> one flight of about 10-15 m; keep areas[north_steps_foot].dz -0.45
r2.north_steps.form.note: Supersedes north_steps.exists_as_flight (round 1, unconfirmed). Flight width and exact riser count: question 2.
r2.north_steps.form.agent_decision: 2026-11-19: the 205 m flight is dropped; build the paver strip and one short flight.

r2.promenade.step_from_green_m.method: Photo scale in gf_10 (1.7 m walkers: the top step is at hip height of a man on the promenade), 4-5 risers; DELTA_FACE_MEASURED.md read 0.6-0.7 m from gf_10 and gf_19.

r2.seawall.retaining_wall_m.method: Published: Daily FT engineering column on the Marine Drive proposal: the sea boundary road sits on a retaining wall about 4 m high near the Delta Face Hotel, falling to 3 m near Parliament. This is the whole wall, including the part below the sand.
r2.seawall.retaining_wall_m.config_key: seawall height configs (delta_face.json seafront, p87 levels)

r2.seawall.height_above_beach_m.method: Two methods: photo scale 2.3-3.0 m (gf_03, gf_04, two 1.7 m walkers), and the published 3-4 m wall less the 0.4-1.0 m of sand at its foot. Lower toward the north end, where a rock revetment replaces the wall. Shadow method failed: the afternoon sun from the SW lights the west face, and the sensor looks from the ENE.
r2.seawall.height_above_beach_m.note: Supersedes seawall.height_above_beach_m (round 1, 2.6 low). Height above the armour rock at the pier: question 3.

r2.levels.road_above_msl_m.method: Published: the same FT column says Centre Road is nearly 4.5 m higher than the sea edge, 100 m away, and the Kollupitiya railway is about 1.5 m above sea level. This is one reading of a single column, not a survey.
r2.levels.road_above_msl_m.config_key: p87 datum.road 3.8 (ESTIMATE): change only with the agent's agreement
r2.levels.road_above_msl_m.note: Stack relative to the road: paver strip +0.15; Green 0 to -0.3; promenade -0.8 to -1.1; sand at the wall foot 2.6-3.0 below the wall top; wall foundation about at sea level.

r2.justice_akbar.carriageway_m.method: OSM: a pair of one-way carriageways (1328043436 EB; 98046409 and 1328043438 WB) 6.4-6.6 m apart centre to centre at 79.8490-79.8500. Esri 2026 crop: one deck with parapets, crossing the railway at about 79.8494, about 12-13.5 m across, with dashed lane lines and a zebra.
sources: Esri World Imagery z19 (Vantor Legion LG05, 2026-02-26, 0.34 m, accuracy 8.47 m per the World Imagery identify service); tiles kept in the session scratch folder only
r2.justice_akbar.carriageway_m.config_key: Justice Akbar oval width (12.6 vs 15.7 m conflict)
r2.justice_akbar.carriageway_m.note: 12.6 m holds; 15.7 m is rejected. About 2 lanes of 3.1 m each way, two-way overall. The section east of the oval is off the loop (drive_circle blk_justice_akbar).

r2.justice_akbar.flyover_planned.method: Project page lists a Justice Akbar Mw flyover (207 x 8.4 m) and an Uttarananda Mw flyover (396 x 10.4 m) in Slave Island. No build date.

r2.baladaksha.flyover_m.method: News: opened 19 Jan 2026, one-way from Delta Face toward Kompannavidiya via Sir Chittampalam A. Gardiner Mw.
r2.baladaksha.flyover_m.config_key: drive_circle north join (check whether the ramps touch the loop)
r2.baladaksha.flyover_m.note: Supersedes the 330 m note in round 1.

r2.towers.heights_m.confidence: high (office tower and ITC hotel medium)
r2.towers.heights_m.method: Published heights cross-checked with OSM height tags and an Esri roof-shift regression. Roof shift = 0.316 m E-W and 0.148 m N-S per metre of height, residual about +-3 m across ITC 225/135, OGF T2 194, Cinnamon Life Suites 136 and Taj 50, so the tags hold to about +-10 m.
sources: Esri World Imagery z19 (Vantor Legion LG05, 2026-02-26, 0.34 m, accuracy 8.47 m per the World Imagery identify service); tiles kept in the session scratch folder only
r2.towers.heights_m.config_key: tower heights from OSM height tags (rules.building_levels: height wins): keep
r2.towers.heights_m.note: Floors: residential towers 51, Shangri-La 32 (Wikipedia 31), office 32-35, Sapphire 55, ITC hotel 29-33.

r2.hotel.facade_height_m.method: Still not measured. Storey-rule estimate 18-20 m to the eaves (4 storeys: about 5 m ground floor plus 3 x 4.3 m), with towers and roofs 4-6 m above that. Tried and rejected: Esri relief and shadow strips (8 m and 12 m, which disagree); a Dotcom panorama at 6.92125, 79.84625 whose facade base sits about 19 px below the horizon (+-50%).
sources: Esri World Imagery z19 (Vantor Legion LG05, 2026-02-26, 0.34 m, accuracy 8.47 m per the World Imagery identify service); tiles kept in the session scratch folder only

r2.hotel.street_door_m.method: Dotcom panorama (Jul 2022 post) at 6.92050, 79.84666, pitch 0: the camera height is 2.2-2.3 m from a 0.7 m traffic cone, and a Delta Road door with its transom measures about 3.8 m against the horizon.
r2.hotel.street_door_m.config_key: hero hotel street doors (2.7 m centres, round 6)

agent.delta_road.colonial_ground_storey_.method: Agent decision 2026-11-19 (not a measurement): the colonial ground storey on Delta Road frontage is 4.5 m. Light decay only on the frontage next to the Delta Face Hotel; empty sponsor slots show the fictional FICT_LankaFizz placeholder.
agent.delta_road.colonial_ground_storey_.config_key: p96 frontage kit v2 ground storey height (Delta Road colonial pieces)

r5.centre_rd.carriageway_edge_to_edge_m.method: Solid white edge line at rot x 636 (A, B; 631 at C) to the right edge line at 823 (816 at C): 187/185 px = 14.4/14.2 m, same at all three stations. Includes the median (2.0 m) at A and C. Scale and rotation: agent aerial, 13.0 px/m, road rotated 23.5 deg to vertical.
r5.centre_rd.carriageway_edge_to_edge_m.config_key: centre_road.nb/sb_carriageway_m (6.6 + 9.4 = 16.0 incl. kerbside, painted centre line); Centre Road name override 6.9 x 2 = 13.8
r5.centre_rd.carriageway_edge_to_edge_m.note: Agrees with 13.8 and with the 14.6 m station at 6.92811 (delta_face_circle.json Centre Road _doc). This stretch is 4 lanes with RAISED medians, not a painted double line.

r5.centre_rd.driving_lane_width_m.method: Lane lines (dashes) at rot x 676 and 784. Left half 636-715 = 79 px = 6.1 m = 2 x 3.05; right half 741-823 = 82 px = 6.3 m = 2 x 3.15. 4 lanes total: (187 - 26 median)/4 = 40 px = 3.1 m. Between the medians (B) lane 2 and 3 widen to fill the 8.3 m between dashes at 676 and 784 (no centre line). Scale and rotation: agent aerial, 13.0 px/m, road rotated 23.5 deg to vertical.
r5.centre_rd.driving_lane_width_m.config_key: delta_face_circle.json way/18598833 width 6.6 (2 x 3.3); way/553338379 9.4 (2 lanes + 2.5 m kerbside)
r5.centre_rd.driving_lane_width_m.note: NB is 2 x 3.1 here (6.2 m), not 6.6; the SB 'kerbside strip' of 2.5 m is not seen here: right of the edge line is a 2.2 m footpath, no parking or bus lane.

r5.centre_rd.median_width_m.method: Raised island outlined by white paint: outer edges 715 to 741 (A) and 711 to 737 (C) = 26 px = 2.0 m over paint; island interior about 1.7 m. Scale and rotation: agent aerial, 13.0 px/m, road rotated 23.5 deg to vertical.
r5.centre_rd.median_width_m.note: Config has no median; agent image shows two raised islands with rounded ends.

r5.centre_rd.median_length_and_gap_m.method: Median 1 spans rot y 120-540 = 420 px = 32 m (both ends rounded). Median 2 starts at y 790 and runs 460+ px (>= 35 m) to the bottom of the crop, so its end is not visible. Gap 540-790 = 250 px = 19 m (centre of the gap is a lighter worn strip with no median). Scale and rotation: agent aerial, 13.0 px/m, road rotated 23.5 deg to vertical.
r5.centre_rd.median_length_and_gap_m.note: Two staggered islands, rounded ends; centre of the road is open between them.

r5.centre_rd.parking_band_m.method: Kerb line at rot x 527 (profile peak at 523-527 in B and C), edge line (parking/driving boundary) at 636: 109 px = 8.4 m. White bay marks occupy x 560-602 (outer marks centred 572, inner 596). Bay depth kerb line to inner mark end 602 = 75 px = 5.8 m; the 2.6 m between 602 and the 636 edge line is plain asphalt (aisle/buffer). Bay surface is pinkish, aisle grey. Scale and rotation: agent aerial, 13.0 px/m, road rotated 23.5 deg to vertical.
r5.centre_rd.parking_band_m.note: Whole parking band 8.4 m vs 7.0 (+1.4): bays themselves 5.8 m (OSM-era note said about 5 m). Agent: parking is the 5th lane and part of the road.

r5.centre_rd.bay_angle_and_pitch.method: Paired marks per stall: outer mark x 572, inner x 596 (24 px = 1.85 m across) and offset 24 px along the road (cross-correlation lag 24): 45 deg. Mark pitch by autocorrelation 46 and 45 px = 3.5 m along the kerb (ac 0.46 and 0.66); 3.5 x sin 45 = 2.5 m perpendicular stall width, a normal bay width, which supports the 45 deg read. Scale and rotation: agent aerial, 13.0 px/m, road rotated 23.5 deg to vertical.
r5.centre_rd.bay_angle_and_pitch.note: Bays angled about 45 deg, 3.5 m pitch along the road; direction of the lean (head-in towards the south or the north) is not fixed by this image.

r5.centre_rd.footpath_kerb_zones_m.method: Left: wall/grass edge at rot x about 280, paving lines at 487, 508, 527 (peaks 487/489, 505-511, 523-527). Right: edge line 823, footpath line 851 (28 px = 2.2 m), dirt verge to about 885 then dense trees. The 15.9 m left zone includes palms, planters and the building bumps, so it is only the extent to the first paving line. Scale and rotation: agent aerial, 13.0 px/m, road rotated 23.5 deg to vertical.
r5.centre_rd.footpath_kerb_zones_m.note: Right footpath 2.2 m agrees with 2.0. Left footpath/paver zone beside the bays is two bands of 1.5-1.6 m before the bays, inside the existing 9.0 m strip.
